label: Franken
research: Two documented disputes may guide identification. BayHStA, Reichskammergericht 4534 (data/documents/1582_9.json) covers Albrecht von Dienheim’s dispute with the male-fief heirs of Albrecht von Rosenberg, including the brothers through their guardians. The court inventory lists proceedings in 1582–1588 and records through 1602, and describes a summons for delayed or denied justice. Separate records document the 1610 sale of Unterschüpf to the brothers and a 1626 copy of the Dienheim heirs’ waiver (data/documents/1610-08-28_2.json and data/documents/1626-02-22_1.json). None of these sources identifies the writ described in Wertheim, G-Rep. 2b Rosenberg 14.
